color.note: Strictly monochrome: black, white, grey. No accent colour, by decision. Names are the kit’s --brand-* contract; a host sets exactly these.

tokens.name: brand-bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The canvas every other token is read against.

tokens.name: brand-fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and the ink hover fill. Also the base of every color-mix() wash (focus tint 4%, active row 9%, tap highlight 10%).

tokens.name: brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text at 11–13px. Check it on the darkest fill it can sit on (the active palette row, --fg at 9%), not on the bare background.

tokens.name: brand-faint
tokens.usage: Captions, meta, placeholders, the ⌘K group labels. AA at body size; do not use it under 12px on a tinted surface.

tokens.name: brand-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the one vertical rule in a bisect section, the nav border on scroll, pre borders. Decorative (1.5:1 on dark), never a control edge.

tokens.name: brand-line-2
tokens.usage: Control borders: chips, the theme toggle, the language pill, the ⌘K card, the mobile menu edge. Visible on its own background in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Strong rules, inverted blocks, the hover/active fill of pills and buttons, ::selection background.

tokens.name: brand-ink-fg
tokens.usage: Text on brand-ink.

tokens.name: brand-scroll-shadow
tokens.usage: Edge fade of horizontally scrolling code blocks (a light glow on dark, since a dark shadow is invisible on #000).

tokens.name: brand-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the ⌘K overlay. Dims toward black in both themes on purpose: a light wash over a light page reads as fog.

tokens.name: brand-tap-highlight
tokens.usage: Touch press wash (-webkit-tap-highlight-color): --fg at 10% instead of the platform’s fixed 18% black, so it follows the theme.

tokens.name: brand-muted-contrast
tokens.usage: brand-muted when prefers-contrast: more — AAA text (7.46:1 light, 10.16:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-faint-contrast
tokens.usage: brand-faint when prefers-contrast: more — AAA text (7.00:1 light, 8.45:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-line-contrast
tokens.usage: brand-line when prefers-contrast: more — 3.45:1 light, 3.06:1 dark (tight, do not lower).

tokens.name: brand-line-2-contrast
tokens.usage: brand-line-2 when prefers-contrast: more — 5.10:1 light, 4.26:1 dark.

families.grotesk: "Archivo Variable", "Archivo", "Onest Variable", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: t-mega
styles.usage: Hero name. letter-spacing -0.035em, text-wrap: balance. Fluid in code: clamp(3rem, 11vw, 9rem)   × --scale.

styles.name: t-h1
styles.usage: Article title. letter-spacing -0.025em. Fluid in code: clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 4.6rem) × --scale.

styles.name: t-h2
styles.usage: Section title. letter-spacing -0.02em. Fluid in code: clamp(1.7rem, 3.2vw, 2.6rem) × --scale.

styles.name: t-h3
styles.usage: Card/project title, blockquote. Fluid in code: clamp(1.2rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem) × --scale.

styles.name: t-lead
styles.usage: Article lead paragraph, in brand-muted. Fluid in code: clamp(1.1rem, 1.6vw, 1.45rem) × --scale.

styles.name: t-body
styles.usage: Body copy. Prose paragraphs use line-height 1.68. Fluid in code: clamp(1rem, 1.1vw, 1.1rem) × --scale.

styles.name: t-meta
styles.usage: Dates, counts, captions, the skip link. Fluid in code: clamp(0.78rem, 0.9vw, 0.9rem) × --scale.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase tracked labels: nav links, section kickers, skip link. text-transform: uppercase; frelikh.com tracks them at 0.14em.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks (0.84em of body) and inline code chips; ⌘K key hints at 0.72rem.

spacing.note: Rhythm is fluid in code (--gut: clamp(20px, 5vw, 72px); --section-pad on the site) and cannot be listed here — see bundle.css.

tokens.name: maxw
tokens.usage: Content container (.wrap) max width.

tokens.name: r-xs
tokens.usage: Hairline corners: focus ring, thin bars, inline code chips.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small buttons, the theme toggle.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Cards, overlays, the ⌘K palette. Nested corners are concentric: inner = outer − gap.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: the language switch, contact pills.

tokens.name: r-circle
tokens.usage: Dots.

tokens.name: z-below
tokens.usage: Decorative pseudo-element behind its box.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky nav.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: Skip-to-content link, above the nav when focused.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette, reading-progress bar.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: A dialog above the palette overlay (reserved).
